name: sap-help-mcp
description: Search SAP Help Portal and SAP Community live, so answers come from the documentation instead of memory.
long_description:
Gives the assistant four read-only tools over two public SAP sources.

**help.sap.com** — official documentation for every SAP product, including the Support Content space: the FAQs, troubleshooting guides and customizing instructions written by SAP support.

**community.sap.com** — blogs, Q&A and discussions, ranked on the client side because the forum API returns unranked, OR-matched results.

No credentials are required and nothing is stored on disk. SAP Notes are deliberately out of scope: reading them needs a personal S-user, so use a dedicated SAP Notes server alongside this one.

Queries are sent to the portals in English; ask your question in any language and the assistant translates it into SAP terminology itself.
